verified_facts: each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
the INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title
INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent
the dataset is a subset of freehold registered property
the INSPIRE ID can be used with Find a Property to retrieve title registration and plan
a registered title can be represented by more than one polygon
polygon identity and title identity must not be conflated
candidate binding must retain the actual INSPIRE feature identifier
quality_effect: Keeps title identity and polygon identity distinct and forbids one-title-one-polygon assumptions.
